feature_units.sex: source binary 0/1; mapping must be verified for new sources

population: Adults already diagnosed with heart failure in the UCI 519 cohort
target: Observed death within 90 days of baseline
censoring: Exclude survivors last observed before day 90; retain deaths before day 90 and all observations at or beyond day 90
normalization: Fixed engineering scales, no fitted population statistics; values clipped to [-10,10] after scaling
limitations: Early-censoring exclusion can introduce selection bias
No calibrated individual clinical risk claim
Not a heart-disease diagnostic or prescription model
No verified hospital labels; all client partitions are simulated
